card.name: Small count numbers before a unit
card.fires_on: Small number words or digits (2, 4, five, eight) that stand for a count or quantity, right where a counted noun or unit such as weeks, tablets, units or bins comes next.

modes.label: Digit before a unit
modes.description: A small digit gives an amount of items or a multiple, in dosing or everyday quantities.

modes.label: Spelled-out count
modes.description: A number word such as five or four gives how many items or events there were.
modes.example: 30 patients treated. There were<< four>> suicides in drug-treated patients in the trials

card.writes: It raises time-span and group words (weeks, years, months, sets, hours, days) and lowers 'two' and 'several', so it favors a count noun after the number.
card.plain: It fires on a small number such as 2, 4 or five when a counted thing or time span is about to follow.
